title: Without Guidance People Fall

questions.question: A false balance is an abomination to the Lord, but a what is his delight?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:1 (ESV): "but a just weight is his delight."

questions.question: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with the humble is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:2 (ESV): "but with the humble is wisdom."

questions.question: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:3 (ESV): "but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them."

questions.question: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, but what delivers from death?
Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:14 (ESV): "but in an abundance of counselors there is safety."

questions.question: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman without what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:22 (ESV): "Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman without discretion."

questions.question: Whoever brings blessing will be enriched, and one who waters will himself be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:25 (ESV): "and one who waters will himself be watered."

questions.question: He who troubles his own household will inherit what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:29 (ESV): "Whoever troubles his own household will inherit the wind,"

questions.question: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and whoever captures souls is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:30 (ESV): "and whoever captures souls is wise."

questions.question: Whoever belittles his neighbor lacks sense, but a man of understanding remains what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:12 (ESV): "but a man of understanding remains silent."

questions.question: The wicked earns deceptive wages, but one who sows righteousness gets a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:18 (ESV): "but one who sows righteousness gets a sure reward."

questions.question: Whoever seeks good finds favor, but evil comes to him who does what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:27 (ESV): "but evil comes to him who searches for it."

questions.question: Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:28 (ESV): "but the righteous will flourish like a green leaf."

questions.question: A gracious woman gets honor, and violent men get what?
The desire of the righteous ends only in good, the expectation of the wicked in what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 11:23 (ESV): "the expectation of the wicked in wrath."

key_verse_text: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
